title: Investigation
description: A bounded inquiry with a defined scope, stated methodology, and lifecycle state. The Investigation entity is the container for all related claims, evidence, sources, and findings.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:investigation:<ulid>. Constant across versions.

slug.description: URL-safe kebab-case identifier. Matches the investigations/ subdirectory name. Example: 'church-committee'.

summary.description: One to three sentences summarising the investigation's scope and purpose.

description.description: What questions this investigation addresses and what time period or events it covers.

in_scope.description: Explicit list of topics, events, or questions that are within scope.

out_of_scope.description: Explicit list of topics, events, or questions that are explicitly excluded.

time_period.description: The time period covered by the investigation.

methodology_notes.description: Any investigation-specific methodological notes that supplement the platform methodology.

created_at.description: When the investigation was first created.

published_at.description: When the investigation was first published (moved to 'published' status).

updated_at.description: When the investigation was last updated.

related_investigations.description: Other investigations that overlap or are directly related.
